title: Quote: There's different things in life you can do. You can become ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Apple and Pixar: Steve's Two Jobs
content: There's different things in life you can do. You can become a painter, you can become a sculptor. You can make something by yourself. But that's not what I do. I do the other thing, which is, you work at things that one person can't do, and that you need large numbers of people to do. I know people like symbols, but it's always unsettling when people write stories about me, because they tend to overlook a lot of other people.
